The `hasNext()` check ensures `next()` is only called when there is at least one more element, thus avoiding the `NoSuchElementException`. Both calls are guarded by prior `hasNext()` checks. Therefore, the throwing condition of `NoSuchElementException` (no more elements) is fully avoided in this context.
